output.reason: The brief ties the drop to one timestamped rule change and backs it with clear evidence: it hits every app and OS version, it affects only password logins, and the blocked users were real customers. That fits the clues I already had and rules out the 6.14 rollback, though I haven't seen the underlying data myself.
